topic: Natural Climate Change Causes and Evidence
key_concepts: Natural climate change has multiple natural causes
Past climate changes are studied using physical evidence
Past climate changes affected biodiversity, ecosystems, and human settlement
Solar activity changes solar irradiance reaching Earth
The relationship between solar irradiance and temperature changed after 1960
Milankovitch cycles of eccentricity, axial tilt, and precession drive long-term climate ch
Orbital changes influence the onset and end of ice ages
Volcanic eruptions inject stratospheric aerosols that alter Earth's radiation balance
Radiative forcing depends on aerosol distribution, altitude, size, and optical depth
The Pinatubo eruption caused measurable short-term cooling and regional weather anomalies
Volcanic aerosol cooling is short-term and spatially uneven
